name: 巴勒斯坦
summary: 巴勒斯坦内政部提供的外国人居留事务官方信息入口；实际入境和居留还可能受其他主管机关控制，具体资格、文件、费用和办理时间尚未由本站复核。
summaryEn: Official foreign-residence affairs entry point from the Palestinian Ministry of Interior; entry and residence may also be controlled by other authorities, and eligibility, documents, fees, and timing have not yet been reviewed here.
